programmes.t: Robbie Coltrane's Critical Evidence: Murder By Mail: Keith Cottingham
programmes.d: In 1984 a parcel bomb was sent to a 53-year-old grandmother living in a tranquil English village. She died of horrific injuries. No one understood why it had happened. The only evidence detectives had was the bomb itself.

programmes.t: Robbie Coltrane's Critical Evidence: The Hitman And The Hairdresser: Fadi Nasri
programmes.d: A 29-year-old hairdresser was found brutally stabbed on her doorstep in a quiet suburban street of London. A recording of a threatening phone call seemed to suggest the motive, but every lead comes to a dead end.

programmes.t: Robbie Coltrane's Critical Evidence: DNA Of A Murder: Andrew George
programmes.d: Hilda Murrell, a 78-year-old distinguished rose-grower, was found dead in woodland near her home town. Despite a huge investigation by the British police, detectives failed to find her killer and conspiracy theories muddied the waters still further.
Glyn Dix shot dead his landlady in 1979. While serving a life sentence he met and fell in love with a fellow inmate’s mother. They married, but three years after his release he killed his wife.

James Fairweather was a 15-year-old boy obsessed with serial killers, violent video games and extreme pornography. He stabbed two strangers to death in separate attacks. He was found unanimously guilty by a jury on 22 April 2016.
Sana Muhammad, formerly known as Devi, had left her unhappy arranged marriage to Ramanodge Unmathallegadoo and remarried. She was a pregnant mother of five when he murdered her in her home.
Stephen Port was convicted of the assaults, rapes and murders of Anthony Walgate, Gabriel Kovari, Daniel Whitworth and Jack Taylor. He was sentenced to life imprisonment with a whole life order.

A gangland feud brings years of murder and mayhem into an inner-city community. Journalist Dermot Murnaghan and detective Clive Driscoll delve into the shocking story of Mark Fellows, and the persistence and ingenuity that brought the feud to an end.

A recently divorced young woman is last seen at an Ohio bar. But without a body or any solid leads, the case goes cold. Decades later, an FBI agent is determined to find out what happened to her. And that means breaking a chilling family pact wide open.

A 77-year-old preacher’s widow is stabbed to death in her Columbus, Ohio apartment. And though the evidence includes a bloody handprint, it will take 25 years—and a family’s persistence—before a tipster’s mother forces him to come clean.

The body of a naked women is dumped along a stretch of Wisconsin highway known as the “killing fields.” Detectives encounter a long list of suspects who refuse to talk. That is, until a tipster offers up a shocking twist that blows the case wide open.

The execution-style killing of a vacuum-cleaner salesman sends shockwaves through an Indiana town. But the truth is darker than anyone could have imagined—years later, an unrelated arrest provides the hook investigators need to reel in the killers.
In a Denver suburb, the new Assistant DA is found dead in her bathtub. The search for suspects leads investigators to Kansas, and the case ultimately hinges on a single hair found at the crime scene.
When a Mississippi mechanic is murdered, local investigators encounter a series of shocking twists, a master manipulator, and an innocent pawn who pays a high price for love.

When Cynthia Borton’s mutilated body is found on her kitchen floor, Iowa investigators suspect her husband - until an arsonist sets the town ablaze, and an even darker suspect emerges from the shadows.

In the California desert, the decomposing body of 54-year-old Henry Stange is discovered in a shallow grave. It will take a shrewd wiretap, a military investigation and a bombshell revelation before a bent hammer points straight to the culprit.

Famous for having a pet lion, larger-than-life college student Robert Pfeil is walking up the long driveway of his rural Wisconsin home when he is shot in the head. At first, detectives suspect a connection to his lover’s jealous husband.
The victim of an apparent hit-and-run, the mangled body of single mother Deborah Boothby is found at the side of a Michigan highway, just steps away from a popular bar.

programmes.t: Crimes That Shook Britain: The London Nail Bombings
programmes.d: London was brought to a standstill in April 1999 when 23-year-old political extremist David Copeland caused terror with a bombing campaign.

programmes.t: Crimes That Shook Britain: The Murder Of Jill Dando
programmes.d: Documentary examining the unsolved murder of British TV presenter and newsreader Jill Dando, who was shot outside her house in Fulham, London, in 1999.

programmes.t: Crimes That Shook Britain: The Dunblane Massacre
programmes.d: In an emotional tribute, witnesses and victims' relatives look back on the tragic murder of 16 children and a teacher at Dunblane Primary School in Scotland, 15 years ago.

programmes.t: Crimes That Shook Britain: Jeremy Bamber
programmes.d: An investigation into Jeremy Bamber's brutal murder of his family in Essex, which occurred in 1985. Sentenced for life, he still maintains he is innocent. Is the right person behind bars?

programmes.t: Crimes That Shook Britain: The Murder Of Rhys Jones
programmes.d: The parents of innocent 11-year-old Rhys Jones, shot on his way home from a football club in Liverpool 2007, speak about the harrowing day when they lost their son.

programmes.t: Robbie Coltrane's Critical Evidence: The Body In The Suitcase: Lorenzo Simon
programmes.d: On 12th May 2014 a human torso was discovered in a suitcase during routine maintenance work on a Birmingham canal. With no useable DNA and no other body parts, the case initially seemed impossible to crack.

programmes.t: Robbie Coltrane's Critical Evidence: Bodies Of Evidence: Roger Severs
programmes.d: In November 1993, Derek and Eileen Severs disappeared without a word. When police spoke to their son, Roger, he insisted they were on holiday. However, there was no evidence of this apparent trip, and Roger was soon arrested on suspicion of murder.

programmes.t: Robbie Coltrane's Critical Evidence: Resolution To Kill: Colin Ireland
programmes.d: In the summer of 1993 a serial killer stalked London. The Metropolitan Police investigated a bizarre murder in which a man was found naked on his bed with a dead cat draped over him. He’d been strangled and his flat had been wiped of evidence.

programmes.t: Robbie Coltrane's Critical Evidence: Little Miss Nobody: Alan Charlton
programmes.d: An old carpet dug up by workmen in a Cardiff back garden in 1989 was the beginning of a case that would push the boundaries of forensic science. The carpet contained human bones - but whose?

programmes.t: Robbie Coltrane's Critical Evidence: The Perfect Murder: Roger& David Cooper
programmes.d: Robbie Coltrane examines the case of two brothers who murdered a marketing manager on Christmas Eve 2014 using chloroform.

programmes.t: Robbie Coltrane's Critical Evidence: Appointment With Death: Scott Singleton
programmes.d: Robbie Coltrane examines the case of Scott Singleton, who murdered a 17-year-old girl after luring her to a bogus job interview.
